note: Both arms read one tree at one path -- the MCP arm's servers read the image's own /data in the run's container, and the mirage /data mount is a copy of it taken out of the same image. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. GitHub is mirage's GitHub fake on both arms, and it holds nothing. The calendar is the Google Workspace fake both arms read, seeded per run from Atlas's export.
